ns2:course.label: International Business Immersion
ns2:course.description: Provides participants an in-depth, experiential immersion into the complex issues and constraints that confront international marketing channel participants. Contextually grounded and themed in a specific industry, the course combines on-campus lectures with an intensive international immersion experience to Europe, Asia, or Latin America. By following the complete marketing channel from raw materials procurement to final consumption, participants gain first-hand knowledge of the necessary managerial decision-making skills required to successfully operate in today's global business environment. Same as BADM 436. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 6 hours for UG credit and 8 hours for GR credit. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
